title: 4/22 first push to the new deploy branch fired no deploy run (paths filter); operator dispatched it by hand
tier_reason: one deploy did not trigger and was dispatched manually the same morning; no delivery, state or recoverability impact is evidenced and the fix was verified by the next push

contract.text: Every push to the dedicated deploy branch triggers the deploy workflow (deploy + canary).
contract.source: commit 1eb432d message body ('deploys fire when deploy branch receives a push'); CLAUDE.md Deployment

mechanism.text: the deploy-branch trigger kept the old push paths filter; per the fix body, GitHub Actions evaluated that filter against no usable baseline for the freshly created deploy branch, so the first main:deploy push started no workflow run

mitigated.action: workflow_dispatch of the deploy workflow on the deploy branch

verified_recovered.how: the push of f6fcc16 to deploy fired run 24788031177 (event push, conclusion success): pushes to the branch trigger again

watchdog.trigger: origin/deploy moves to a new SHA and no deploy workflow run for that head starts within 10 minutes, or a run concludes success while the box HEAD (deploy_history reflog) differs from that head
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a run for the pushed head concludes success and the box HEAD equals the pushed SHA

evidence.what: the first main:deploy push that day silently skipped the canary workflow (paths filter vs a freshly created branch); the canary had to be kicked via workflow_dispatch
event workflow_dispatch on branch deploy at 02bb8e0, created 2026-04-22T15:40:18Z, conclusion success; no deploy run exists between 24730297455 (4/21 15:11Z, main) and this one
event push on branch deploy, head f6fcc16, created 2026-04-22T15:47:07Z, conclusion success: the first push-triggered deploy-branch run
4/21 19:03 ET switch of the trigger from main to deploy kept the paths filter and added workflow_dispatch
until 4/28 the workflow ran git pull --ff-only of origin/main on the box, so a successful deploy-branch run applied new code only if origin/main had also been pushed

notes: the paths-filter explanation is the fix body's (operator inference about GitHub semantics), not verified against GitHub docs here
E37 caveat (ev5): whether the 11:40 manual dispatch actually installed new code depends on origin/main having been pushed; unknown
recovery latency = verified trigger (11:47:07) minus onset bounds (not before 00:00 ET, not after 11:40:18)
